description: Analyze a SYNTHETIC biomarker panel with Phi Longevity's PRISM engine. Returns 3-tier, evidence-cited recommendations (THIS WEEK / CONSIDER / ASK YOUR CLINICIAN). For research/education with SYNTHETIC or de-identified data only. Do NOT submit protected health information (PHI). This endpoint is stateless and does not store inputs.

biomarkers.description: Map of biomarker name -> numeric value, e.g. { "Hemoglobin A1c": 5.4 }. SYNTHETIC ONLY.

include_partner_options.description: If true, include partner/product options. Default false (clean clinical output).

name: analyze_biomarkers
